title: AG40024: Environmental Biotechnology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Cleaner bioprocesses and sustainable development; classification and
characterization of wastes, analytical techniques in environment monitoring;
wastewater biotreatment: characteristics of wastewater, aerobic and anaerobic
wastewater treatment processes; activated sludge process, trickling filter,
lagooning process, rotary disc biological contractor, photosynthetic wastewater
treatment, biomethanation process, biological treatment of solid wastes:
downstream processing of biological waste treatment processes, landfill
technologies, bioinsecticide, biofertilizer, biological fuel generation
(biodiesel, bioethanol, biohydrogen), bioremediation of hazardous wastes,
biomarker, biosensor.
